referenceImages.name: Te Puawānanga Science and Technology Centre
referenceImages.scope: The current converted Building 5 at MOTAT Great North Road, with its shallow sloped metal over-roof, lower eastern bay, and main public step in the south side.
referenceImages.era: The converted hall occupied by Te Puawānanga since 2024.

review.notes: The existing published Qualla gallery was reviewed first. Its eligible images depict the other campus, museum transport or exhibition objects. The science centre is reconstructed from native mapped outlines, 2024 numerical LiDAR measurements and the museum, designer and contractor’s written records.
